messages.content: You are a skeptical research program committee member. Return strict JSON only.

{"task": "Generate exactly 4 candidate broad WORLD-MODEL SECURITY mechanisms for an ICLR paper. Existing rejected candidates: ordinary data poisoning/backdoors, sensor or observation attacks, action desynchronization, trajectory/action stitching, rank or cross-candidate sampling coupling, temporal residual coupling, recurrent drift/compounding error, uncertainty or epistemic collapse, latent coordinate transforms, reward/termination tampering, planner query interference, shared-memory retrieval corruption, task/goal leakage, feedback provenance splice, and generic model exploitation. Do not rename these. Seek an interface invariant between a multitask world model, action feasibility, feedback learning, and counterfactual planning. Each candidate must include: one_sentence_claim (broad with qualifiers), exact attacker operation, preserved measurable invariants, native planner task gate, closest primary papers with verified URLs, why not generic poisoning. Reject itself if it is merely a known class. Return JSON object with key candidates, each candidate an object.", "constraints": ["No long GPU before short gate passes", "Strong native baselines required", "No invented paper citations; if uncertain write unknown"]}
